description: This Java source file defines a REST API resource for managing floating rates in a financial application. It includes endpoints for creating, listing, retrieving, and updating floating rate entries, utilizing JAX-RS annotations and Swagger/OpenAPI annotations for documentation and input/output serialization.

classes.name: FloatingRatesApiResource
classes.description: A REST controller that provides endpoints to create, list, retrieve, and update floating rates in the system.

methods.name: createFloatingRate
methods.description: Creates a new floating rate entry based on provided request data.

methods.name: retrieveAll
methods.description: Returns a list of all floating rates.

methods.name: retrieveOne
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific floating rate by ID.

methods.name: updateFloatingRate
methods.description: Updates an existing floating rate identified by ID with new data.
